message:
So the fuzz target reads a config file. The input is a config file content. The vulnerability is in `lxc_safe_int64_residual` not null-terminating the residual buffer. The callers are `set_config_time_offset_boot` and `set_config_time_offset_monotonic`, which are triggered by config keys like `lxc.time.offset.boot` and `lxc.time.offset.monotonic`.

Let me find the config key names and how they're parsed.

<｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
<｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=command>grep -n "time.offset\|time_offset\|set_config_time_offset" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lxc/src/lxc/confile.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
</｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
